written.headline: AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs in five years: JP Morgan
written.summary: A JP Morgan Wealth Management report estimates that AI could displace around 24 million knowledge-worker jobs globally over five years. The report notes that much of the adjustment may happen through leaving roles unfilled rather than through layoffs.

written.headline: Ethan Mollick on AI's potential to solve wicked problems
written.summary: Ethan Mollick posted on Bluesky that AI can cheaply deliver personalized human-level help in any language to cellphone users. He argued that this makes complex problems in education, healthcare, and development potentially tractable.

written.headline: Dante Security raises $10M seed to monitor enterprise AI agents
written.summary: Dante Security has launched out of stealth with $10M in seed funding led by NFX to provide a platform for monitoring autonomous AI agents within organizations. The platform discovers agents, traces their actions, and assigns a named human owner to each agent.
